shortDescription: Poland's largest construction company Budimex GPW:BDX said on Wednesday that it plans to accelerate international diversification, while maintaining its domestic lead.It also underscored plans to expand into energy, defence and nuclear infrastructure in its "Strategy 2030+" plan.Source text:($1 = 3…

children: said on Wednesday that it plans to accelerate international diversification, while maintaining its domestic lead.
It also underscored plans to expand into energy, defence and nuclear infrastructure in its "Strategy 2030+" plan.
Budimex expects the domestic market to grow by roughly 7-10%, driven by investments in transport, energy, defence and industrial infrastructure
Large-scale infrastructure projects such as Port Polska and Poland's first nuclear power plant will support growth, the company said
It forecast a compound annual revenue growth rate of at least 8% for 2026 to 2030 and average EBIT growth of at least 6%, and said it plans to run a stable dividend policy
Budimex estimated foreign markets' share in revenue to grow to 10% to 15% in the period from 8.5% in 2015 to 2025, with opportunities in the Czech Republic, Germany and Rail Baltica
The company said it has identified addressable opportunities of nearly PLN 1 trillion ($252.53 billion) in Poland, the Czech Republic and Germany
It estimated the Ukrainian reconstruction market at $96 billion to $188 billion, but said its strategy for the country depends on the geopolitical situation
